quotes.card: HAT-P-17 is a K-type main-sequence star about 92.4 parsecs (301 ly) away.

notes: HAT-P-17 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
